columns.comment: PRD-PAYABLES-FINANCE or PRD-RECEIVABLES-FINANCE; join gold.dim_product.

columns.comment: dim_client version of the anchor valid on the invoice date (as-was, D11).

columns.comment: Trade-platform party id of the anchor.

columns.comment: Coverage office of the anchor (ISO-2).

columns.comment: SCF supplier id (supplier of the anchor; not a bank client).

columns.comment: Supplier name (fictional).
columns.name: supplier_name

columns.comment: Supplier country (ISO-2).
columns.name: supplier_country

columns.name: supplier_onboarded_date

columns.comment: True when the supplier's own payments route to another bank (an account-opening opportunity).

columns.comment: Supplier's invoice number.
columns.name: supplier_invoice_no

columns.comment: Invoice date (the grain date).
columns.name: invoice_date

columns.comment: First day of the month of invoice_date.
columns.name: invoice_month

columns.comment: Date the anchor approved the invoice for payment / financing.
columns.name: approval_date

columns.comment: Invoice due date (the anchor pays the bank / supplier then).
columns.name: due_date

columns.comment: Invoice currency (ISO 4217).
columns.name: currency

columns.comment: Approved invoice amount in USD (flow).
columns.name: invoice_amount_usd

columns.comment: True when the supplier drew down (financed the invoice early) - a drawdown.
columns.name: is_financed

columns.comment: Drawdown date (null when not financed).
columns.name: financing_date

columns.comment: First day of the month of financing_date (null when not financed) - use for Financed USD by month.
columns.name: financing_month

columns.comment: Amount advanced to the supplier in USD (0 when not financed; flow at financing_date).
columns.name: financed_amount_usd

columns.comment: Share of the invoice advanced (0-1).
columns.name: advance_rate

columns.comment: Annual discount rate charged (% p.a.).
columns.name: discount_rate_pct

columns.comment: Days from financing to the due date (null when not financed). Average Days Financed = SUM(days_financed) / count_if(is_financed).
columns.name: days_financed

columns.comment: financed_amount_usd x days_financed (USD-days, for the annualised yield).
columns.name: financed_usd_days

columns.comment: Discount (financing income to the bank) in USD (0 when not financed).
columns.name: discount_amount_usd

columns.comment: Cash paid to the supplier = financed amount - discount (USD).
columns.name: net_proceeds_usd

columns.comment: Approved (awaiting due date), Financed (drawn, not yet due), Settled (financed and repaid) or Paid at Maturity (not financed).
columns.name: status

columns.comment: True when financed on / before 30-Sep-2026 and not yet due (counts in the programme's drawn amount).
columns.name: is_outstanding_at_as_of

comment: Supply-chain-finance invoices from Apr-2024: one row per approved supplier invoice uploaded to an SCF programme (payables / receivables finance) with the anchor buyer (golden client), the supplier (name, country, onboarding, whether it banks elsewhere, spend segment), invoice / approval / due dates, invoice amount, and - when the supplier drew down (is_financed) - the financing date, financed amount, advance rate, discount rate, days financed, discount (financing income) and net proceeds. Amounts are flows by their dates (additive). Yield bps = 10000 x SUM(discount_amount_usd) / SUM(financed_usd_days / 365). Suppliers are not bank clients (no golden id); golden_client_* is the anchor. Grain: one row per SCF invoice (invoice_id).
